fallback_wrappers.current: PasskeyStepUpOwner then TotpStepUpOwner wrap the prior source; typed outcomes forward unchanged, boolean Apply methods currently project to .Applied.
fallback_wrappers.proposed: RecoveryCodeStepUpOwner last explicit opt-in. Preserve complete typed outcome/carrier/validities and existing safe completion hooks; never cache the payload in an owner instance.
fallback_wrappers.selection: Extend the existing mutually exclusive pending-owner cookie selection to all3 owners. Clear other pending selections on new action; invalid present own selection remains fail-closed. Result cookies stay safe and separate.

frontend_change: One optional recovery-only same-stack consumer, invoked before safe parent completion/unmount/redirect. Keep StepUpCompletion secret-free; no generic payload registry. Reject/discard an unexpected first-delivery field, never log it.
